title: Making seed-paper cards
instructions: 本题图表、地点与数据均为项目原创模拟，不是官方雅思试题。独立用20分钟完成至少150词的首稿；先不看示范或提示。提交后再进行真实AI评阅和订正，证据不足保持待评。
prompt:
The diagram shows the process used by a small workshop to make greeting cards from recycled paper and flower seeds. Describe the stages in the process.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

figure.title: Workshop production of seed-paper cards · one-way process
steps: Sort used paper and remove plastic or metal
Tear the paper and soak it in water for 12 hours
Blend the soaked paper into pulp
Stir flower seeds into the pulp by hand
Spread the mixture over a mesh frame
Press out excess water and lift the wet sheet
Dry the sheet on a rack for 24 hours
Cut and fold the dry sheet into greeting cards
